kpis.description_fr: Volume NGL transporté + traité. Driver principal P&L Oneok. Tailwind Permian production + export demand.
kpis.description_en: NGL transported + processed volume. Oneok's main P&L driver. Permian production + export demand tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: Gas Gathered = volumes gas collectés des puits puis livrés aux pipelines. Croissance avec production basin Bakken + Permian.
kpis.description_en: Gas Gathered = volumes collected from wellheads then delivered to pipelines. Grows with Bakken + Permian basin production.

kpis.description_fr: Merger Magellan Midstream closé juillet 2023 pour 18,8 Mds $. Ajoute refined products + crude pipelines. Transforme Oneok en C-Corp midstream géant.
kpis.description_en: Magellan Midstream merger closed July 2023 for $18.8B. Adds refined products + crude pipelines. Transforms Oneok into midstream C-Corp giant.

kpis.description_fr: EnLink Midstream + Medallion Midstream acquis 2024 pour ~5,9 Mds $. Ajoute Delaware basin gathering + processing. M&A serial.
kpis.description_en: EnLink Midstream + Medallion Midstream acquired 2024 for ~$5.9B. Adds Delaware basin gathering + processing. Serial M&A.

kpis.description_fr: 90 % CA via contrats fee-based long-term. Exposition prix commodities minime = stabilité cash flows. Modèle midstream classique.
kpis.description_en: 90% revenue via long-term fee-based contracts. Minimal commodity price exposure = stable cash flows. Classic midstream model.
